mapper.select: SELECT u.id as vlogerId, u.nickname as nickname, u.face as face FROM fans f LEFT JOIN users u ON f.vloger_id = u.id WHERE f.fan_id = #{paramMap.myId} ORDER BY u.nickname ASC
